## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

This 1-fascicle text by [竺曇無蘭](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%AB%BA%E6%9B%87%E7%84%A1%E8%98%AD) Zhú Tánwúlán treats the famous narrative of *Mahākāśyapa* hastening from his retreat to the Buddha's *parinirvāṇa*-site (the *Kuśinagara*) — a foundational episode of the post-*parinirvāṇa* sangha-history.

**Abstract**

The translation belongs to Tánwúlán's Eastern-Jìn period (381–395 CE).
